name: @fly/fly-brain
description: Deterministic LIF connectome library for murmur fly agents — production topology is the real FAFB 783 FlyWire MB+CX subgraph (10,361 neurons / 467,314 synapses, CC-BY 4.0); a procedural PRNG generator (1,080 n default) remains as fallback. Motor decoder, ethogram engine and market stimuli included. Pure TypeScript, no native or WASM dependency.
